race.comment: NORTH DAKOTA (3) resumes. He showed ability last time in, placing in two runs before a spell, both in town. He tried hard behind the highly progressive Ertijaaj at Caulfield Heath before a break and can improve this time in, watch the market. REAL COMEDY (5) resumes now with the Price & Kent Jnr yard having had one run in New Zealand to date. Have to respect the connections and stable bringing him here. QUEMAX (4) is a Circus Maximus gelding on debut for the O'Brien yard. Williams booked from a good gate, he can run well. MR SPENDEDOE (2) didn't fire last time but had been coming along well prior and is in the mix.
